apps.name: TwitchUnblock TV
apps.subtitle: Twitch lives and VODs on Apple TV
apps.localizedDescription: Followed channels, top streams, categories and search, lives and VODs with the chat on the picture.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Menu now closes an open category instead of quitting the app
- A channel's page only shows the Collections tab when the channel has collections (loaded with the page), instead of an empty tab
- In Following, moving down from the tab bar now lands on the first card of the first row, and up and down always reach the neighbouring row (Continue watching, Live, Offline), even when it has fewer cards
- Traditional Chinese interface language (thanks to trend0522)
- Account → About shows the app's version and build number
- Choose where the "Continue watching" row goes in Following (above the live channels, below them, or hidden) in Account → Settings; a "Live" title now heads the live channels
- Press and hold a "Continue watching" video to resume it or remove it from the list
- A channel's page now has Videos, Clips and Collections tabs, like the iPhone; a clip plays with its broadcast's chat
- Menu on a channel's page always goes back to the list, even on an offline channel without videos (it used to quit the app)
- Other improvements and fixes

- A "Continue watching" row at the top of Following lists the VODs started on this Apple TV, with their progress
- During a channel's ad break, a banner explains the purple screen with a countdown to the stream's return
- Other improvements and fixes
